Recommended Delicious Restaurants in Me Quang
Jul 2025 • Couples
I went in because it was close to the hotel at noon. There were few customers because the time was a bit off. We had mee quan (noodle originated in Da Nang, with plenty of vegetables) and buncha (Vietnamese dipping noodles). It was delicious for everyone. Buncha is made with a lot of chot garlic. I had Me Quang at another restaurant the day before, and I personally liked this one because it tasted refreshing. I recommend it!

It was a good decision
Mar 2024 • Friends
Since "My Quang" was near our hotel, we discovered it after a walk. It made a good, cozy impression and
was well attended. So we ate here for dinner.
We sat outside on the small terrace, which was clean and tidy.
The menu is small but also in English and with photos, so it's easy to choose something. The dishes came quickly and were tasty.
The service was very sparse due to a lack of English skills, but that didn't bother us at all. The restaurant is reasonably priced.
The "My Quang" was a good decision.

Good place to try local food
Jul 2023 • Family
We were searching for a nice place to have dinner (local Danang cuisine) and after stumbling along a few places, we chanced upon this place and decided to try it.

No regrets absolutely as the My Quang, fresh spring roll and pork skewers were just mouth watering and delicious. It’s slightly pricier than the other shops but the taste, ambience and friendly service more than made up for it.

Even the fruit smoothies were just super yummy.

Will definitely return again for more meals!!
